posts.text: Who knew I’d be spending my summer building AI-powered security tools at a bank? 😄 This summer, I had the opportunity to intern at TD, where I worked on Python automation, AI agents, Java modernization, and deploying applications to Linux servers. One of my biggest projects was building an AI-powered AppSec remediation solution to help reduce software vulnerabilities.
